description: Wall-eject window (ACU-RE-0055, flat-wall side exit). ACU.exe 748abdc6...7e40, base 0x140000000; guards from the mapped image (motion-link-20261020). sub_141A0D730(S, id, value) sets per-window byte flags on the parkour state S (id 4 -> S+529, id 6 -> S+542 the wall-eject window, id 39 -> S+540 ...). sub_141A1B940 (jump gate) calls the wall-eject evaluator sub_141A8CAA0 while S+542 is set, else per-wall-run-type handlers (types 51-56) while S+529 is set. sub_14157D310 sets S+541 = a2 and S+542 = 1. Registers only: window_set edx = id, r8b = value; jump_gate r9d = a4, [rsp+0x28] = a5.
